row.notes: Wwise job scheduler helper (inferred). Writes tag and the handle into out; if dependency != -1 links it via FUN_144ce6140. Then for the handle (low 12 bits index a 0x38 byte job table at global 0x145fbf3d8) atomically clears the top bit of the state word +0x30; if the remaining count is 0 enqueues the job to its queue (+0x1c, 4 queues) via FUN_144ce5840 and wakes that queue (FUN_144ce5f30).
